scientific_integrity: Analytic derivation based on exact transition recurrences and rational generating functions; a standalone independent finite-state exact-rational checker supports selected sizes and is not an infinite proof. Numerical source values are attributed to their authors.
scientific_limitations: Finite simple n-sunlets with n>=5, one seed, synchronous independent-attempt probabilistic zero forcing; the theorem is for the expected completion time and not the full hitting-time distribution. Historical-priority uncertainty persists; there is no independent validation.
title: Exact finite-size propagation time of probabilistic zero forcing on sunlet graphs
